title: Controller unreachable versus a valid webhook denial
required_authorization: Separate explicit environment and experiment authorization; no automated provisioning is included
preconditions: Disposable cluster with Kyverno v1.20.0 and one ValidatingPolicy (Deny) on pods in a test namespace
Policies with failurePolicy Fail and Ignore in separate namespaces
procedure: Create one compliant and one violating pod with the controller healthy
Scale the admission controller to zero
Repeat both creates in each namespace
acceptance: Healthy: compliant admitted, violating denied with the policy message
Unreachable + Fail: both creates rejected with a call error, no policy message
Unreachable + Ignore: both creates admitted unevaluated
capture: Pinned Kubernetes, Kyverno controller and CLI versions with image digests
Sanitized before/after objects and admission responses
Timestamps and the target cluster identity
stop_conditions: Unexpected deletion outside the test namespace
cleanup: Delete only the disposable cluster or the named test namespaces; verify teardown.
